decisive_items: brown, multilobular lesions confined to the deep corneal stroma
no conjunctival hyperemia, no discharge, and no epithelial defect
central infiltrate involving all corneal layers and a peripheral infiltrate concentrated in the deep stroma
response.rationale: Post-DSAEK corticosteroid use and deep stromal brown multilobular lesions without epithelial defect or pain favor fungal keratitis; Acanthamoeba typically causes severe pain and epithelial defects, and the prior Thaumetopoea infection had resolved.

rejected.why: Acanthamoeba keratitis usually presents with severe pain, epithelial defects, and ring infiltrates; here there is no pain or epithelial defect.
The Thaumetopoea pityocampa infection resolved before surgery and is not the cause of the current keratitis.
